retrieval: Read-only public WooCommerce Store API GET; catalog_visibility=any; per_page=100; pages checked against X-WP-Total and X-WP-TotalPages.
authority: WooCommerce Store API prices are the current public storefront projection. The official CSV is the reviewed repository/import source. Neither is substituted for the other.
published_catalog_limit: Store API returns published catalog data; drafts/private products are outside this public snapshot. catalog_visibility=any includes published hidden/catalog/search visibility where exposed.
reconciliation_scope: Simple and variation products only; variable family parents excluded from product rows.
reconciliation_method: Only active public price owners are compared; blank canonical prices are source-data gaps, and non-purchasable products are excluded from price-difference claims.
